definitions.explanation: To forcefully expel saliva from the mouth. Considered rude behavior in public.

examples.japanese: ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{唾|つば}を{吐|は}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦マナー→マナー：11139_manaa⟧⟦{違反|いはん}→違反：01824_ihan⟧だ。
examples.english: Spitting on the street is bad manners.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{地面|じめん}→地面：00125_jimen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{唾|つば}を{吐|は}いて⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{歩|ある}き{去|さ}った。
examples.english: He spat on the ground and walked away.

examples.japanese: ⟦{公共|こうきょう}→公共：11652_koukyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{唾|つば}を{吐|は}く⟦{行為|こうい}→行為：10021_koui⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{条例|じょうれい}→条例：08255_jourei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: In some areas, the act of spitting in public places is prohibited by local ordinance.

notes:
The literal meaning is to spit saliva ({唾|つば}). Figuratively, spitting is a gesture of contempt: {唾|つば}を{吐|は}きかける means to spit at someone. Hurling insults is not {唾|つば}を{吐|は}く: the verb ⟦{吐|は}く→吐く：04397_haku⟧ takes the words themselves as its object, as in ⟦{暴言|ぼうげん}→暴言：12975_bougen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吐|は}く→吐く：04397_haku⟧ (to hurl abuse) and {悪態|あくたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吐|は}く→吐く：04397_haku⟧ (to swear at someone).

The related expression ⟦{天|てん}→天：28464_ten⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{唾|つば}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to spit at heaven) is a proverb meaning that insults directed at others will come back to harm oneself.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{唾|つば}を{吐|は}く: to spit on the road
- {唾|つば}を{吐|は}きかける: to spit at (someone)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{痰|たん}→痰：17896_tan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吐|は}く→吐く：04397_haku⟧: to spit phlegm — specifically expelling phlegm
- {吐|は}き{捨|す}てる: to spit out, to say dismissively — emphasizes contempt in the way something is said
- ⟦{毒|どく}→毒：10052_doku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吐|は}く→吐く：04397_haku⟧: to make venomous remarks — to say something deliberately hurtful
